main_text.p: In quo legato non quidem heres legatario rem quae relicta est iubetur tradere, sed vendicanti legatario non permittitur prohibere.

8 Praeceptionis{a} vero legatum non nisi vni{b} ex heredibus dari potest, vt aliquid ei ex hereditate præ-cipuum relinquatur. & si aut coniunctim, id est, mutis, aut disiunctim singulis relinquatur, omnibus vnā res tantum quae nominata est debetur non vni res{c}, & alij æstimatio, sicut in legato damnationis est constitutum.Formulas legandi per præceptionē vide apud Vlpianum 24. §.6.Paul.3.sent. 6.§.1.§.6.in f. §. eod.
main_text.head: TIT. VI.
DE LEGE FALCIDIA{d}.
main_text.p: v.2. Instit. 22.35. ff.2 :6. C.9 : adde 25. Vlp.32:Paul. 3.sent.8.LEGE[?] Falcidia constitutum est: quicunque heres fuerit institutus, quartam{e} partem totius hereditatis habeat. Quod si testator hereditatem suam legatis exinanierit, hoc statutum est, vt Falcidiam sibi de imminutione legatorum heres retineat, con-stante nihilominus testamento. Hic de Pauli sententiis addendum.d.§.32. §.1. in f.Instit. eod: l. 73. ff.ad l. Falcid. Paul. 3. sent. 8.§.1.
main_text.head: TIT. VII.
DE FIDEICOMMISSIS{f}
main_text.p: v.25. Ulp: 4. Paul.sent. 1 de fideicommissariis haereditatibus 2.Instit 23: de singulis rebus per fideicommissum relictis 2. Instit. 24.§.2. Instit. de fideicommissar. haeredi-tatib.POTEST[?] aliquis recto iure heredem instituere: & rogare eum, vt hereditatem suam, aut omnem, aut ex parte alij per fideicommissum reddat. Nam si heredem directo iure non instituerit, fidei-commissarius non poterit ad alium acceptam hereditatem transmittere. Sed in hac quoque re hoc ob-seruandum est, quod de Falcidia supra iam dictum est, vt heres in restituendo etiamsi omnem hereditatem alij restituere iussus sit, ita hereditatem alij restituat vt quartam{h} sibi ex ipsa hereditate retineat.de quarta Trebelliani ca v.§.4. Instit. de fideicommiss. hære dit. & ad Sc. Trebel: l.1.§. 2.ff.ad Trebel.
{i} Instit.de singulis reb.per fideicommiss. I[?], & legatum 24.Vlp.25.

page.notes: Woodcut initials: the decorative initial at "LEGE" (first word of the Falcidia section) and at "POTEST" (first word of the Fideicommissis section) are hard to read; the likely letters L and P are given with [?]. The reference mark after "fideicommissum" in the last line looks like a k-like sign with no matching note in the margin; it is copied as {k} and is doubtful. The marks "{e}" and "{h}" are read from small superscript letters and are less certain. "præ-cipuum" is hyphenated at the line end and the æ/præ spelling is uncertain. "Falcidiam" is read as printed. The footnote's Roman numeral after "fideicommiss." is uncertain ("I," or "Ix"). The left-margin note "h" ends at "ff.ad Trebel."; its tail "legatum 24.Ulp.25." runs on into the footnote line, so it is kept there. The left-margin notes "g" and "f" have no matching mark in the text and are placed beside the first lines of their sections. Long s is printed as f throughout and is transcribed as plain s.
